problems: No page failed; WebFetch relays page text through a summariser, so quotes are as relayed (long sentences come as fragments of at most 125 characters).
The Pacification of Libya URL returned the same text as Second Italo-Senussi War (apparently one article); both are listed as sources of senussi-order.
The Jaghbub page summary contained a Senussi return to Jaghbub in 1928 that contradicts the page's own 1926 occupation; not used.

Contests and the 1932 loss of senussi-order are recorded against both italian-libya and italian-africa because both cite it; the 1912-1917 contest region copies italian-africa ledger 16/19 including Tripolitania, which no page supports as Senussi land.

italian-libya ledger 13 and italian-africa ledger 38 record Kufra 1931 as a gain from nobody; senussi-order records it as a Senussi loss. french-algeria ledger 2 records Bougie 1833 as from nobody; beylik-of-constantine records it as a Beylik loss.

british-south-africa-company: the united-kingdom dossier has no matching vassal events, and british-africa ledger 3, 6, 8 draw the same Rhodesian land as British Africa's, so the two overlap once compiled. Validator warns (3) that southern-rhodesia and northern-rhodesia have no dossier yet.
beylik-of-constantine is drawn from 1830, not the infobox's 1528, because until Algiers fell it was a province of the Regency (decision recorded in the dossier notes).
tunjur-kingdom start (1450) and new-oyo start (1835) are confidence-1 bridges; both states' shapes are placeholders (soft).
